index_hero_subtitle: Malin-Wallet is born from the vision of a unified, secure, and intelligent crypto experience. Inspired by the simplicity of BlueWallet, we're taking the next leap forward.
index_hero_text: We believe in a future where Bitcoin (including Lightning), Ethereum, and Solana coexist seamlessly in one wallet. No more switching apps, no more complexity. Just pure, unadulterated access to the decentralized world.
features_security_text: Your keys, your crypto. Malin-Wallet is a non-custodial wallet, meaning you have full control over your assets. All cryptographic operations and sensitive data are encrypted and stored locally on your device.
features_current_text: Based on initial analysis, Malin-Wallet currently supports foundational wallet operations. (Note: A full source code audit would provide a more detailed list).
features_current_item1: Secure asset storage for multiple chains.
features_roadmap_text: We are constantly building and improving. Here's what's coming next:
features_roadmap_item2: A unified gallery for your NFTs across all supported chains.
features_gemini_text: Malin-Wallet is integrated with Gemini AI to provide you with an unparalleled level of security and assistance. Gemini acts as your co-pilot, helping you with:
features_gemini_item1: Smart contract auditing before you sign a transaction.
features_gemini_item2: Answering your questions and guiding you through the complexities of DeFi.
about_text: Malin-Wallet is more than just a project; it's a passion for a decentralized future. We are a small, dedicated team aiming to build the most secure, intuitive, and intelligent wallet for the next wave of crypto users.
about_contact_text: Have questions, feedback, or want to collaborate? Reach out to us.
about_google_cloud: Developed with the support of Google Cloud infrastructure.
